Hi Sara / Amanda / Jorge —

Thanks again for committing to list MetricWorks on AWS Marketplace and GCP Marketplace alongside our co-sell plan. I pulled together a short checklist so we can confirm gaps and owners before we kick the publisher onboarding sprint next week. Key asks:

- Security evidence: MetricWorks to upload SOC2+infra diagrams (stub indicated) — we need these for both marketplaces.
- Listing spec: product tile copy, screenshots, and usage-based pricing lines (see attached listing_spec_v2.pdf).
- Co-sell eligibility: Amanda, please confirm any outstanding AWS GTM attachments we should include (co-sell workbook / purchase_order templates).
- Joint GTM: agree on 60-day pilot offering and sales handoff playbook.

Ben / Rishi — can you validate pricing SKU alignment and confirm whether Redwood will offer the reserved SKU discount during the pilot?

Sara — can you upload the security bundle to the drive link and drop a note when complete? I attached a small template for procurement and a pricing spreadsheet to iterate (co-sell_MVP_pricing.xlsx).

Next steps: Quick sync Tuesday 11 Aug, 10:00 PT if that works for everyone.

Best,
Grace
Grace O'Connor
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference

Looping in quick pricing notes since this will impact seat vs consumption alignment:

- Redwood is prepared to offer a 15% reserved-capacity pilot discount for MetricWorks for 60 days if the pilot converts to a committed reserved amount within 90 days of launch. We will need a signed MOU from MetricWorks to lock the pilot discount (I can draft).
- SKU mapping: please follow the pattern MW-RED-<PRODUCT>-<UNIT>. For GCP we recommend the same SKU text but GCP requires a numeric productId in their console; Jorge, would you confirm where that appears in the listing flow?

Grace — I'll attach a short MOU template after this thread. Sara — can you confirm internal approvals on committing to the 90-day conversion clause?

Ben

Thanks everyone — quick clarifications from AWS side:

- PRC (Partner Resell Certification): you do not need a final PRC to start the listing submission, but PRC must be cleared before co-sell leads are routed. We can accept the initial listing package while PRC is in progress.
- Co-sell workbook: please include 1) target accounts list, 2) proof-of-value deck, and 3) contact for joint-engagements (AM contact + MetricWorks AE). Amanda requests these in the Drive folder.
- For billing: AWS will support both usage-based and seat-based SKUs; ensure your SKU descriptions in listing_spec_v2.pdf match the manifest (Ben's MW-RED pattern is fine).

Action items:
- Sara: upload the target accounts spreadsheet to the drive and tag Amanda by EOD Aug 14.
- Grace / Ben: provide the MOU draft (Ben said he'll send).
- Rishi: we'll need a short legal checklist from Redwood (data processing addendum + audit contact) — can you drop that in the drive?

Will follow up after I review the listing package.

Amanda Singh
AWS Partner Programs
